theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_fbl_rescaled_sandwich
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)) (r : ℝ) (k : ℕ), 0 < r → closedBall x (2 * r) ⊆ U → (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → (∫ z, min 1 (((k : ℝ) + 1) * max 0 (1 - ‖z.1‖)) * β z.2 ∂(rescaledMeasure V x r)) ≤ (∫ z in closedBall x r ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / r ^ n ∧ (∫ z in closedBall x r ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / r ^ n ≤ ∫ z, max 0 (1 - ((k : ℝ) + 1) * max 0 (‖z.1‖ - 1)) * β z.2 ∂(rescaledMeasure V x r)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
